about.title: Lompoc Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a traffic collision takes a life in Lompoc, the grief is immediate but the legal questions often aren't. Santa Barbara County recorded a traffic death in the most recent final crash year, alongside dozens of injury collisions on corridors like Rt 1, H Street, Rt 246, and O Street. For families left behind, California law allows a wrongful death claim separate from any criminal proceedings — but only certain people qualify to bring it, and the clock starts ticking the day of death. We handle wrongful death cases and can help you understand who has standing, what losses may be recoverable, and how to move forward without adding legal stress to an already painful time. There's no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

items.title: Standing Isn't Always Obvious
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim — typically a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. We can help your family understand where you fit.

items.title: The Two-Year Deadline Is Firm
items.desc: California generally gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though claims against a government entity often require action much sooner. Waiting too long can close the door on a claim entirely.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Bills
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs and lost financial support, but California law also recognizes the loss of love, companionship, and guidance a family has suffered. We can help make sure all of these are accounted for.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Under California law, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children usually have first priority to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may qualify. We can review your family's specific situation to clarify who has standing.

items.question: Does a wrongful death claim depend on a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, even if the driver also faces criminal charges. Your family can pursue a civil claim regardless of the outcome, or existence, of any criminal proceeding.

items.question: Is there something specific about Lompoc roads that matters for these claims?
items.answer: Corridors like Rt 1, H Street, Rt 246, and O Street see a meaningful share of Lompoc's reported collisions, and crash reports tend to cluster around Friday early evenings. That pattern doesn't determine fault, but it can help us understand the context of a collision when building your claim.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk with us?
items.answer: Nothing. Our initial consultation is free, and we work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless your family recovers compensation. Reaching out to learn more costs you nothing.
